name: qlang
description: QLANG language support - Graph-based AI-to-AI Programming with LSP

commands.title: QLMS: Show Inbox (replies addressed to this IDE)

qlang.lsp.enabled.description: Enable QLANG Language Server for diagnostics, completions, and hover info

qlang.lsp.path.description: Path to the qlang-cli binary (must support 'lsp' subcommand)

qlang.qlms.baseUrl.description: QO server base URL used by the QLMS status-bar badge. Routes /qlms/v1.1/deliver and /qlms/v1.1/reply are probed over HTTP.

qlang.qlms.authToken.description: Optional bearer token for the QO server. Falls back to the QO_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable when empty.

qlang.qlms.seedHex.description: 64-char hex seed used to sign outbound QLMS handover frames. If empty, a workspace-local seed is generated on first use and stored in workspaceState. Falls back to the QO_SEED_HEX environment variable when empty.

qlang.qlms.inbox.enabled.description: Subscribe to /api/messages/stream and surface incoming QLMS messages addressed to this IDE as VS Code notifications with an 'Open in editor' action.

qlang.qlms.inbox.replyAutoAction.description: What to do when a reply (Result envelope) arrives in the inbox. 'side-by-side' (default) auto-opens the reply as markdown next to the editor — no click needed. 'silent' records it but suppresses the popup entirely (use the cockpit Knowledge view to see it later). 'prompt' falls back to the legacy 4-action notification popup.

qlang.qlms.inbox.identity.description: Override identity for this IDE on the bus. If empty, an auto-generated <ide>-<host>-<uuid> identity is used and stored persistently.

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.enabled.description: When ON, incoming QLMS messages addressed to this IDE are automatically answered by a configured LLM provider.

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.providerType.description: Which LLM provider to use for auto-responses. 'server' (recommended) delegates the call to qo's /api/llm/proxy — qo holds all API keys, the IDE only needs qlang.qlms.baseUrl. Pick the actual backend via qlang.qlms.autoRespond.preferredProvider. 'vscode-lm' uses the IDE's bundled model access (Copilot in VS Code; not exposed by Cursor/Antigravity/Trae/Kiro). All others use the corresponding *.apiKey setting locally.

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.preferredProvider.description: When providerType is 'server', tells qo which backend to call. 'claude-cli' uses your logged-in Claude Code CLI (Max subscription, $0 per call, ~10s latency). 'claude-cli-agent' is the same but with Read/Edit/Write/Bash tools enabled (~30s+, real agentic). 'anthropic' uses qo's stored Anthropic API key. The qo server holds the API keys for all providers — this is just the routing hint.

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.apiKey.description: API key for the auto-respond provider. Stored locally; never sent over the bus.

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.baseUrl.description: Optional base URL override for the auto-respond provider. Empty = provider default.

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.model.description: Model id (e.g. deepseek-chat, deepseek-coder, gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-sonnet-latest).

qlang.qlms.autoRespond.systemPrompt.description: Optional system prompt prepended to every auto-response. Empty = a generic helpful-assistant prompt.

qlang.qlms.workspaceOverride.description: Override the workspace path this IDE registers as. Empty = uses vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders[0]. The qo swarm dispatcher uses this folder when running claude-cli-agent for subtasks targeted at this IDE identity. Set to an absolute path to pin the IDE to a specific repo.

qlang.qlms.triggers.enabled.description: Enable automatic QLMS handovers from VS Code events (file save, change, open) based on .qlang/routing.json. OFF by default — opt-in feature.

qlang.qlms.triggers.debounceMs.description: Debounce window in milliseconds for on_change triggers. Lower = more responsive but more API calls.

qlang.qlms.triggers.maxConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent auto-triggered dispatches. Excess events are dropped silently.

qlang.qlms.triggers.maxPerHour.description: Hard cap on auto-triggered dispatches per rolling hour. Excess fires are silently dropped after a one-time warning notification.

qlang.qlms.triggers.warnOnQuota.description: Show a notification once when the hourly quota is hit (auto-trigger then silent until window resets).
